question: The commercial banks of India have to maintain a minimum percentage of cash, gold and other securities before lending loans to its customers. This is called the ______.

options.text: Current Account and Savings Account Ratio

solution:
The correct answer is __**Statutory Liquidity Ratio**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Statutory liquidity ratio(SLR) is a government term where commercial banks are mandated to have a specific proportion of deposits in the form of liquid assets by the Reserve Bank of India(RBI).__

 
• It is determined by the RBI.
 
• It is used to control inflation and fuel growth, by decreasing or increasing the money supply.
 
• Liquid Assets, Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) and SLR Limit are the three components&nbs
